Amara N. Diallo
Senior Project Manager — Digital Health & Public Sector Systems
Profile
PMP-certified project manager with 11 years of experience leading digital transformation projects for
government and public health clients. Specializes in case management systems, stakeholder coordination
across multi-site deployments, and Agile delivery for regulated environments.
Relevant Experience
Lead Project Manager — National Immunization Registry Modernization (2023–2024)
l
Managed a 14-person cross-functional team delivering a case/registry management platform for a national
health ministry across 40+ clinics.
l
Coordinated integration with an existing national health data exchange, similar in scope to NHIE-style API
integrations.
l
Delivered the project on budget and within a 10-month timeline using a phased Agile rollout.
Project Manager — Regional Social Services Case Tracking System (2021–2022)
l
Led requirements workshops with 200+ field staff across 8 regional offices.
l
Oversaw UAT and staff training rollout for a case management system serving both web and mobile users.
Certifications
l
PMP (Project Management Professional)
l
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)

M.Sc. in Information Systems Management
